info.title: Task Manager transactional API
info.description: All writes require a unique idempotencyKey; updates require expectedVersion. Identity comes exclusively from the validated Supabase JWT. Claim tokens are private credentials returned only to their executor. A direct human must use intervene_task to complete, move, reassign or delete claimed work. Generic commands and REST aliases share the same SQL authorization.

post.description: Deletion is rejected with validation_error if a surviving task would lose a dependency, attachment, or other task relation. Remove such relations explicitly using the surviving task expectedVersion and, for agents, its valid claim token before retrying. Project deletion may remove relations wholly internal to its deleted task set; any active descendant claim must first be explicitly released by human intervention.

post.description: Duplicate canonical file metadata. expectedVersion is the source file version. The source and its attachment joins are unchanged; joins are not copied. Unknown metadata and project/task ownership are preserved. The server renews ID, creation time and author, including legacy aliases. Agents retain existing restrictions on task-owned or attached files. Returns the FileMetadata DTO with createdAt (ISO timestamp), authorUserId and legacyMetadata.

200.description: Committed canonical Task data with taskId alias equal to its NEW id, and one durable event identity. Replay returns the same IDs and key.

Task.description: get_task/list_tasks include a live safe reservation or null. executorAgentId is an independent assignment; reservation.active uses server time. claimToken is never readable here.

assignee.description: Historical/local identity metadata; never an Auth membership.

due.description: ISO date, empty string or null.

create_subtask.description: expectedVersion is the parent task version; each successful subtask mutation increments the parent. Details return in legacyMetadata.

assignee.description: Historical/local identity metadata; never an Auth membership.

due.description: ISO date, empty string or null.

update_subtask.description: expectedVersion is the parent task version; each successful subtask mutation increments the parent. Details return in legacyMetadata.

batch.description: Atomic ordered commands in this workspace only. Any conflict rolls back all effects, events, logged queue messages and idempotency. Replay returns the same child results. Nested batches, workspace creation and claim/renew/release are forbidden. Preallocate text IDs for templates/promotion; supply successive parent versions. N children consume N+1 rate units; no claim credentials are returned.

id.description: Existing source ID. Exact, unnormalized Unicode string; no leading-character or punctuation restriction. Must contain a non-whitespace character under ECMAScript trim, contain no NUL or unpaired surrogate, and be at most 128 UTF-16 code units (astral characters count as two). PostgreSQL-only whitespace IDs or IDs above that UTF-16 limit are excluded.

newId.description: Optional new ID; generated by the server when omitted. Exact, unnormalized Unicode string; no leading-character or punctuation restriction. Must contain a non-whitespace character under ECMAScript trim, contain no NUL or unpaired surrogate, and be at most 128 UTF-16 code units (astral characters count as two). PostgreSQL-only whitespace IDs or IDs above that UTF-16 limit are excluded.

name.description: Optional name. Default: source.name.replace(/(\.[^.]+)$/, ' copy$1'); extensionless names remain unchanged.

duplicate_file.description: Duplicate canonical file metadata. expectedVersion is the source file version. The source and its attachment joins are unchanged; joins are not copied. Unknown metadata and project/task ownership are preserved. The server renews ID, creation time and author, including legacy aliases. Agents retain existing restrictions on task-owned or attached files.

id.description: Exact nonblank identifier; UTF-16 length bound; no NUL or lone surrogates.

projectId.description: Explicit destination project. Exact ID; same string restrictions as id.

duplicate_task_graph.description: Source-authoritative atomic task graph copy. Requires source expectedVersion and agent claimToken when applicable. Task mode preserves status and done completion time; project mode resets todo. Fresh task/subtask IDs, key and creation/update times, no archive/executor/lease/run, full metadata and relation copies. Original file ownership and dependency targets retained; no comments or recurrence successor.

TeamMembershipBaselines.description: Optional exact relationship snapshots for selected users, compared in the current workspace under its transaction mutex before this create/update. User IDs must be unique (UUID case ignored); team IDs are unordered sets with no duplicates. An empty teamIds array asserts no current team. An empty guard list is valid. Missing current membership or any changed, removed, or foreign team relation returns version_conflict (409) and rolls back the whole batch. Invalid shape/duplicates return validation_error (422). Omission preserves existing multi-team behavior. Guard is not entity metadata. Authorized idempotent replay returns the receipt without rerunning these preconditions. Existing batch limit 100 and input limit 262144 apply to the entire request; no chunking.

items.description: Exact unnormalized team ID. At most 128 UTF-16 code units, nonblank under ECMAScript trim, no NUL or unpaired surrogate. A numeric string is valid; a JSON number is not.
